basis: Current public REST API documentation links the fields endpoint, whose current response lists HAS_BOOK, BOOK_ID, OPEN_ACCESS and TITLE; real core records expose bookid, hasBook, isOpenAccess and parent-title metadata.
scope: Bookshelf records indexed by Europe PMC including chapters/entries. 32362 is provider match count, not independent books or guaranteed complete Bookshelf coverage.
operator_deduplication: NCBI/NLM Bookshelf content; Europe PMC metadata service operated by EMBL-EBI. Overlaps existing europe-pmc connector; no additional source/origin created.
direct_ncbi_access: No NCBI request sent. Prior E-utilities/FTP robots restrictions remain binding. Reader links not fetched.
rights: Provider open-access flag retained separately from any copyright/license and reading verification; no unrestricted metadata/content reuse claim.
